data.body:
_More from Khopkar · Miscellaneous topicals & wound care_

**Class:** Enzymatic debriding agent (clostridial collagenase from Clostridium histolyticum)

## Mechanism of action
- Digests native collagen in necrotic tissue → selective debridement without harming viable tissue

## Indications in dermatology & STI
- Debridement of chronic dermal ulcers and severe burns (necrotic/sloughy tissue)
- Injectable collagenase: Dupuytren contracture, Peyronie disease (systemic forms)

## Dose & formulations
- Once daily to the wound bed (2 mm layer), covered with moist dressing; stop when wound is clean

## Adverse effects
- Local erythema, burning

## Contraindications
- Hypersensitivity

## Drug interactions
- Inactivated by silver, iodine, hexachlorophene, heavy metals and acidic solutions

## Pregnancy & lactation
Acceptable.

## Viva points
- Selective enzymatic debridement; incompatible with silver/iodine

_Sources: Khopkar ch.32 (Collagenase); Wolverton 4e ch.54. Facts summarised in our own words; Wolverton followed where books differ._
